title: Support filtering GET /books by author and tag
body:
Clients need to filter the catalogue:

- `GET /books?author=martin` → books whose author contains the text (case-insensitive)
- `GET /books?tag=craft` → books that have exactly that tag
- both filters can be combined; with no filters the full list is returned as today.

Please add tests.
plan:
Add server-side filtering for GET /books by author substring (case-insensitive) and by tag (exact match), and extend tests to cover new filtering behavior including combined filters.
1. Update GET /books handler to apply optional author and tag filters
2. Add tests for author and tag filtering in test/server.test.js
requirements: GET /books supports optional query parameters: author, tag
author filter is case-insensitive substring match against book.author
tag filter matches books whose tags array contains exactly the specified tag
filters can be combined; when both provided, both conditions apply
GET /books without filters returns full catalogue (existing behavior)
New tests verify: /books?author=martin returns books authored by Martin (case-insensitive), /books?tag=craft returns books with tag craft, and /books?author=martin&tag=craft returns intersection
Tests must pass against existing catalog in src/data/books.json
Code changes touch only server route and minimal test additions; no refactors or dependency changes
No changes to data format or other endpoints
